lines.en: label saraspring1:
scene nightsky

It’s as good a night as any to drown my sorrows in alcohol. And I’m sure Sara would agree as that is both her chosen method for doing the same thing {i}and{/i} she’ll manage to make some money out of it.
lines.zh: 今晚和任何一晚一样，适合借酒消愁。而且我确信 Sara 也会同意——这既是她消愁的首选方式，她{i}还{/i}能顺便从中赚点钱。

lines.en: However, now that her daughter has a newfound (or newly open) affinity for extracting semen from my body, there’s a good possibility I’ll be able to drown my sorrows in a different, {i}cheaper{/i} way.
lines.zh: 不过，既然她女儿如今新近（或者说刚刚公开）迷上了从我身体里榨出精液，我很有可能会用另一种{i}更便宜{/i}的方式消愁。

lines.en: I’d probably pay if she really asked me to. But I’m glad she took after her mother’s thirst for teacher cock as I just happen to be a teacher who possesses one.
lines.zh: 如果她真的开口要，我大概也会付钱。但我很高兴她继承了她母亲对教师鸡巴的渴望，而我恰好就是个有鸡巴的教师。

lines.en: Anyway, beer.
lines.zh: 总之，啤酒。

lines.en: Sex.
lines.zh: 性。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck1
And orchestrated encounters with a small family of angels.
lines.zh: 还有与一个天使之家精心安排的相遇。

lines.en: : Oh! Hey. I wasn’t expecting you to show up tonight.
lines.zh: : 哦！嘿。我没想到你今晚会出现。

lines.en: : Neither...was I...
lines.zh: : 我也……没想到……

lines.en: : Why? I come here all the time. What reason would you possibly have to believe that?
lines.zh: : 为什么？我可是常来这儿的。你有什么理由会那么以为？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck2
: I think we’ve just developed a Sensei-sense by now. A sense-ei, if you will.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们现在已经进化出一种「Sensei 感应」了。你要愿意，也可以叫它「sense-ei 感应」。

lines.en: : Can you...please stop making terrible puns? Even if this particular one is...mostly correct.
lines.zh: : 你能不能……别再讲烂谐音梗了？哪怕这一个……其实还挺贴切。

lines.en: : Not if you want to stay in business, Sana. This building is quite literally built on top of a terrible pun.
lines.zh: : 想让我继续营业就别想了，Sana。这栋楼可是实实在在盖在一个烂谐音梗上面的。

lines.en: : Well, yes— I am here. So your Sensei-sense is clearly lacking.
lines.zh: : 好吧，是的——我来了。所以你的「Sensei 感应」显然不太灵。

lines.en: : Now, please provide me with ten beers so that I may drink myself into a stupor and ignore all of my other problems.
lines.zh: : 那么，请给我十杯啤酒，好让我喝到不省人事，把其他所有烦恼都忘掉。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck3
: No can do! I’ve got a job for you since you just so happened to wander in at the perfect moment.
lines.zh: : 那可不行！我这儿有个活儿要交给你，谁让你偏偏在这个完美的时刻晃进来了。

lines.en: : Are you...really going to make him come with you?...And just...leave me here on my own again?...
lines.zh: : 你……真要让他跟你走吗？……就这么……又把我一个人丢在这儿？……

lines.en: : Wouldn’t you be...better suited for that, don’t you think?...
lines.zh: : 那件事不是……更适合你去做吗，你不觉得吗？……

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck4
: Nope! I trust you with my bar and my life, Sana. Plus, you’ve done it a million times before. And, if everything goes according to plan, you won’t {i}have{/i} to start doing that again.
lines.zh: : 不行！我的酒吧和我的人生都交给你了，Sana。再说你以前做过一百万次了。而且，如果一切按计划进行，你就{i}不用{/i}再做那种事了。

lines.en: : I feel like I get dragged into “missions” more often than I’m supposed to here.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我被卷进「任务」的次数，比我该被卷进去的次数要多。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck5
: Blame this one on Yuki, not me. She’s the one who keeps forgetting to show up for her shifts.
lines.zh: : 这次要怪 Yuki，别怪我。是她老忘了来上班。

lines.en: : Again? Really?
lines.zh: : 又来？真的假的？

lines.en: : She was...supposed to be here tonight, but...I guess she...forgot?...
lines.zh: : 她……本来今晚该来的，但……我猜她……忘了？……

lines.en: : That excuse made sense last time. But if that {i}keeps{/i} happening, something else is probably going on.
lines.zh: : 这个借口上次还说得通。但要是{i}老{/i}这样，那多半是出了别的事。

lines.en: : Exactly. Which is why I’m headed over to her place now to make sure everything’s okay.
lines.zh: : 正是。所以我这就要去她家看看，确认一切都好。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck6
: And why {i}you{/i} get to come with me so I’m not abducted in the middle of the night and sold into the sex trade!
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}要跟我一起去，这样我就不会半夜被绑架、卖进性交易市场！

lines.en: : Alternatively, you could stay here and we could just...{i}let{/i} her be abducted.
lines.zh: : 或者，你可以留在这儿，我们就……{i}任由{/i}她被绑架好了。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck7
: Boooooo. Surely {i}you{/i} don’t want me to be trafficked. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 切——。{i}你{/i}肯定不想我被拐卖吧。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Ten beers please, Sana.
lines.zh: : 十杯啤酒，谢谢，Sana。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck8
: Coming right up, Sir.
lines.zh: : 马上来，先生。

lines.en: : After all we’ve been through, you’re going to just let me become someone’s sex slave?!
lines.zh: : 我们经历了这么多，你竟然要让我变成别人的性奴隶？！

lines.en: : I’m not {i}letting{/i} anything happen. I just can’t imagine the sex trade is going very strong right now on account of nearly every male being somewhere in space. This is a calculated, low-risk move.
lines.zh: : 我没有{i}放任{/i}任何事发生。我只是觉得现在性交易大概不景气，因为几乎所有男性都在太空的某个地方。这是个经过计算、低风险的选择。

lines.en: : Sana, I would expect this from! But not you, Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sana 这么说我还不意外！但你不该啊，Sensei！

lines.en: : Okay, fine. I’ll come with you. But only because hearing that you’d {i}expect{/i} your daughter to be okay with this is very sad.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。我跟你去。但只是因为听到你说「你{i}以为{/i}你女儿会无所谓」，实在太让人难过了。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck9
: Yay! I’ll take what I can get.
lines.zh: : 太好了！有总比没有强。

lines.en: : But what if someone barges in here with a gun and {i}I{/i} get sold into-
lines.zh: : 可要是有人拿着枪闯进来，然后{i}我{/i}被卖——

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck10
: Actually, I’ll probably be fine. You two can go.
lines.zh: : 其实，我大概没事的。你们俩去吧。

lines.en: : Yay! You heard the girl! Come on, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 太好了！你听到人家说的了！走吧，Sensei！

lines.en: scene black
: Are you sure that’s a note you’re okay leaving on?
lines.zh: : 你确定留这么个「便条」走人也没问题？

lines.en: : Everything will be fine! You’re the most intimidating customer we get. So if {i}you{/i} haven’t laid a finger on Sana yet, I doubt anyone else is going to.
lines.zh: : 一切都会没事的！你是我们这儿最吓人的客人。所以既然{i}你{/i}到现在都没碰过 Sana 一根手指，我怀疑也没别人敢。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck11
: I repeat — are you sure that’s a note you’re okay leaving on?
lines.zh: : 我再说一遍——你确定留这么个「便条」走人也没问题？

lines.en: : I don’t have much of a choice. For all we know, Yuki could be in greater danger than Sana is. And sending {i}her{/i} out on her own is out of the question entirely. Bye, Sana!
lines.zh: : 我没多少选择。说不定 Yuki 的处境比 Sana 更危险。而且让{i}她{/i}一个人出去是完全不可能的。再见，Sana！

lines.en: : But...you {i}could{/i} stay here and-
lines.zh: : 可是……你{i}可以{/i}留下来然后——

lines.en: : Bye, Sana! Your mom is going on a date!
lines.zh: : 再见，Sana！你妈妈要去约会啦！

lines.en: : No she’s not! But have fun! Take your time!
lines.zh: : 才不是！不过玩得开心！慢慢来！

lines.en: : If Yuki’s actually in trouble, do you really think we should be taking this so...{i}lightly?{/i} She has ties to the Yakuza. That’s pretty serious, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 如果 Yuki 真的有麻烦，你真觉得我们该这么……{i}轻描淡写{/i}吗？她跟黑道有关系。那还挺严重的吧？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck12
: Oh, please. Have you {i}seen{/i} Yuki? I’m pretty sure she could take the entire Yakuza out on her own. This is just a normal wellness check. I’m sure everything will be fine.
lines.zh: : 拜托。你{i}见过{/i} Yuki 吗？我很确定她一个人就能把整个帮会端了。这只是一次普通的健康探访。我确信一切都会没事的。

lines.en: : Famous last words, Sara. Once you say that, you pretty much solidify that everything is going to not {i}be{/i} fine.
lines.zh: : 著名的遗言啊，Sara。你一说这话，基本就等于把「一切都会{i}出事{/i}」给钉死了。

lines.en: scene black
: Well, then we need to go and figure that out! Bye, Sana! Date!
lines.zh: : 那我们更得赶紧去弄清楚了！再见，Sana！约会！

lines.en: : Not a date! But still have fun!
lines.zh: : 不是约会！但还是玩得开心！

lines.en: : Date! Bye!
lines.zh: : 约会！拜拜！

lines.en: : Mom! Stop-
scene sarayukicheck13
We’re outside now. I think we’re on a date.
lines.zh: 我们现在到了外面。我觉得我们是在约会。

lines.en: if sarasex == False:
Which, to be fair, I’m not really cool with. But it makes Sara happy and there are clearly bigger issues that need to be addressed right now.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，我其实不太乐意。但这让 Sara 开心，而且眼下显然有更大的问题需要处理。

lines.en: else:
I’m pretty sure it’s the kind that won’t end in sex, though. Especially since the entire purpose of it is to...make sure Yuki is still alive?
lines.zh: 不过我很确定这是那种不会以上床收场的约会。尤其是因为我们此行的全部目的就是……确认 Yuki 还活着？

lines.en: To be honest, I can’t help but worry. Because even though I’m not particularly {i}close{/i} with Yuki, she has hollowed out {i}some{/i} kind of spot in my mind or heart or wherever it is feelings come from.
lines.zh: 老实说，我没法不担心。虽然我和 Yuki 并不算{i}亲近{/i}，但她在我脑海里、心里、或者随便哪个感情冒出来的地方，挖出了{i}一个{/i}位置。

lines.en: : No answer again. I’ve called her like twenty times now.
lines.zh: : 又没人接。我都打了差不多二十次了。

lines.en: : And...how many times has she missed work exactly?
lines.zh: : 那她……到底缺了多少次班？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck14
: Four or five, I think. I haven’t exactly been keeping track. But I haven’t really {i}needed{/i} to since business has started to slow down again.
lines.zh: : 四五次吧，我想。我倒没认真数过。不过生意又开始变淡，我也真{i}不必{/i}数。

lines.en: : Any idea why?
lines.zh: : 知道为什么吗？

lines.en: : Not a clue, really. It feels like it just happened overnight or something. It’s fine, though. Chances are some new bar opened and people are just high on that right now.
lines.zh: : 真的一点头绪都没有。感觉就像是一夜之间发生的事。不过没关系。大概是开了家新酒吧，人们正上头呢。

lines.en: : But that’s one more reason I have to figure out what’s going on with Yuki as soon as possible. We’ll need all hands on deck once the masses start returning.
lines.zh: : 但这也是我得尽快搞清楚 Yuki 那边怎么回事的又一个理由。等人潮一回来，我们就得全员上阵。

lines.en: : So this is purely a business venture we’re on right now?
lines.zh: : 所以我们现在出门纯粹是为了生意？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck15
: Of course it’s not {i}purely{/i} a business venture. Yuki’s my friend. If she was {i}just{/i} an employee, I probably would have only called her, like...five times.
lines.zh: : 当然{i}不纯粹{/i}是为了生意。Yuki 是我的朋友。如果她{i}只是{/i}个员工，我大概只会打……五次电话。

lines.en: : Have you brought this up {i}at all{/i} to her? How did she explain her absence the first time? Or the times after that? Because there’s no way she’s just missed four or five shifts in a row, without-
lines.zh: : 你跟她提过吗？她第一次缺席是怎么解释的？还是之后那几次？因为她不可能连着旷四五次班而——

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck16
: Sensei, I know you’re worried. I am too. I’m not just ignoring Yuki’s “history.” I know who she is and what she suffers from.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我知道你担心。我也担心。我没有无视 Yuki 的「前科」。我知道她是什么人，也知道她在受什么苦。

lines.en: : But I’ve got it under control.
lines.zh: : 但我已经把局面控制住了。

lines.en: : Not wanting my little girl to be out in the dark alone isn’t the only reason I didn’t want her going over to Yuki’s place, you know.
lines.zh: : 我不想让我的小女儿一个人摸黑出门，并不是我不想让她去 Yuki 家的唯一原因，你知道的。

lines.en: : I’m prepared for the worst.
lines.zh: : 我已经做好最坏的打算了。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry to drag you into it...but I’m way more comfortable with you by my side.
lines.zh: : 把你卷进来，我很抱歉……但有你在我身边，我踏实多了。

lines.en: : Now, let’s get a move on.
lines.zh: : 那么，我们动身吧。

lines.en: : The quicker we get to her, the quicker we can rest.
lines.zh: : 越早到她那儿，我们就能越早安心。

lines.en: scene black
scene sarayukicheck17
I’ve been here before — with a smaller her.
lines.zh: 我来过这里——和她更小的那个版本一起。

lines.en: And while their silhouettes are similar, there’s one inarguably closer to mine in more ways than one could count.
lines.zh: 虽然她们的轮廓相似，但有一个毫无疑问在数不清的方面更接近我。

lines.en: It’s better at matching my pace. And in between imperfectly timed steps, there’s no massive gap in size that would cause the laymen to question just how “it” would fit and how much it would hurt.
lines.zh: 它更跟得上我的步子。而在那些节奏并不完美的脚步之间，也不存在巨大的体型差距，会让外行人怀疑「它」到底怎么塞进去、又会有多疼。

lines.en: She’s older than me. She doesn’t know that yet, but it’s the truth. Yet, I’ve never seen her as an older sister.
lines.zh: 她比我大。她还不知道，但这是事实。然而，我从未把她当成过姐姐。

lines.en: if saraspecial30p2 == True:

There are things we have in common. Things that no one should. But it’s the type of connection that can only strengthen a bond when you {i}want{/i} it to. At all other times, it’s the kind that should be feared.
lines.zh: 我们有些共同点。是那种谁都不该有的共同点。但这是那种——当你{i}希望{/i}它加深羁绊时，它就能加深羁绊的联系。而在其他任何时候，它是那种应该被畏惧的东西。

lines.en: Like two people witnessing a murder — locking eyes before heading their separate ways and forgetting they ever saw anything. Or at least trying to.
lines.zh: 就像两个目击了谋杀的人——在对视之后各奔东西，忘了自己曾看见过什么。或者至少努力去忘。

lines.en: That’s the way it feels sometimes. Like we not only {i}see{/i} each other, but we can see into each other’s pasts.
lines.zh: 有时候就是这种感觉。好像我们不光能{i}看见{/i}彼此，还能看进彼此的过去。

lines.en: And I’m not sure how comfortable either one of us is about that. Especially when I’ve yet to divulge much of mine to her in any form.
lines.zh: 而我不确定我们俩对此有多自在。尤其是我还没把自己的过去向她吐露过多少。

lines.en: Regardless, I can see her.
lines.zh: 无论如何，我能看见她。

lines.en: And in this light, despite it illuminating the path to somewhere much darker, she is beautiful as always while I step closer to the shadows to accentuate the difference.
lines.zh: 而在这片光下——尽管它照亮的是通往某个更黑暗之处的路——她一如既往地美丽，而我走向阴影，好把这份反差衬托得更明显。

lines.en: jump restofsaraspring1
else:

A good friend is more apt of a description, I suppose. But despite how good she {i}is,{/i} there’s this sort of...untapped or inaccessible knowledge that I {i}want{/i} to grab hold of but {i}can’t.{/i}
lines.zh: 我想，说「好朋友」更贴切些。但尽管她{i}这么好{/i}，总有那么一种……未被发掘或无法触及的、我{i}想{/i}抓住却{i}抓不住{/i}的知识。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s a life in which we’re closer. Maybe not as close as brother and sister, but close in a form where she would spread her legs or open her mouth with me upon command.
lines.zh: 我确信在某个世界里我们更亲近。也许没亲如兄妹，但亲近到我一声令下，她就会为我张开腿、或者张开嘴。

lines.en: Would she drop to her knees right now if I uttered the required words? Or would she make me take her out to dinner first?
lines.zh: 如果我现在说出那句该说的话，她会立刻跪下吗？还是说她会先让我带她出去吃顿饭？

lines.en: These are the bits of knowledge I’ve elected to forego in the name of protecting her offspring.
lines.zh: 这些就是为了保护她的后代，我选择放弃去了解的知识。

lines.en: But I am certain-
lines.zh: 但我确信——

lines.en: There are much more important details in the fabric that are lost to my unclean eyes.
lines.zh: 这块织物里还有更重要的细节，是我这双不洁的眼睛看不到的。

lines.en: scene black
There are no words the rest of the way.
lines.zh: 剩下的路上没有一句话。

lines.en: It appears I haven’t earned them.
lines.zh: 看来我还没挣到那些话。

lines.en: $ saraspring1 = True
$ sara_love += 1
{i}Sara’s affection has increased to [sara_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sara 的好感度提升到了 [sara_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}But she will always be a side character.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但她永远只能是个配角。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And you will continue to crawl away from a world that’s breaking down behind you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而你会继续从一个正在身后崩塌的世界里爬走。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The pieces to your puzzle have fallen somewhere between the cracks. But you’re too scared to turn around and search for them.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你那块拼图的碎片掉进了某道缝隙里。但你太害怕，不敢转身去寻找。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And maybe you’re better off that way.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}也许你这样反而更好。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But maybe such a decision will make it possible to ever get out?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但也许，正是这个决定才让「逃出去」成为可能？{/i}

lines.en: {i}There’s only one way of knowing.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}只有一种方法可以知道。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But there’s one more for someone stronger.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但对更强的人来说，还有另一种。{/i}

lines.zh: ///////////////////////LOCATING “YUKISPRING1”

lines.en: ///////////////////////DESTINATION LOCATED
lines.zh: ///////////////////////DESTINATION LOCATED

lines.en: jump yukispring1
label restofsaraspring1:
: So...it’s been a while since I’ve “checked in” on you.
lines.zh: : 那么……我有一阵子没「探望」过你了。

lines.en: : Probably on account of the whole coma thing. And the immeasurable sadness that has become my everyday life.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为那档子昏迷的事。还有那已经成为我日常生活的、无可计量的悲伤。

lines.en: : Has your outlook on the world not changed since becoming a father?
lines.zh: : 当了父亲之后，你看世界的眼光就没变过吗？

lines.en: : Did yours change when you became a mother?
lines.zh: : 你当了母亲时变了吗？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck18
: Of course. It’s pretty noticeable going from having {i}no{/i} reason to live to having an extremely clear one. Was it not like that for you?
lines.zh: : 当然变了。从「{i}没有{/i}活下去的理由」变成「有一个极其明确的理由」，这变化相当明显。你不是这样吗？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck19
: Maybe it was years ago. I can’t...vividly remember that far back. But just changing what I call Ami hasn’t made as big of an impact on me as I thought it would at first.
lines.zh: : 也许很多年前是这样。我……记不清那么久以前的事了。但只是改变我对 Ami 的称呼，对我的影响并没有我一开始以为的那么大。

lines.en: : Hm.
scene sarayukicheck20
: Guess I’m just a better parent than you, then.
lines.zh: : 那就是说我比你更会当家长咯。

lines.en: : Guess so.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : The choice is always there for you to join my family, though. Maybe adding another daughter to the mix could shock you back into the initial thrills of fatherhood?
lines.zh: : 不过，加入我们家的选项一直都在。也许再添一个女儿，能把你震回初为人父的那种刺激里？

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m not sure I could ever look at Sana as a daughter anymore. Sorry, Sara.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不确定我还能把 Sana 当女儿看了。抱歉，Sara。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck21
: Who says I’m talking about Sana? Maybe I’m suggesting that I want you to put a {i}new{/i} baby in me?
lines.zh: : 谁说我在说 Sana 了？也许我是在暗示，我想让你在我肚子里种个{i}新{/i}宝宝？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck22
: Wait- why wouldn’t you be able to look at Sana as a daughter, though? It’s not because she’s one of your students, is it? Because Ami-
lines.zh: : 等等——可你为什么不能把 Sana 当女儿看？不是因为她是你学生吧？因为 Ami——

lines.en: : No, it’s not that. She’s just...
lines.zh: : 不，不是那个。她只是……

lines.en: : She’s been...different lately.
lines.zh: : 她最近……不一样了。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck23
: {size=-10}D...{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-10}不……{/size}

lines.en: : Different how? Because I told you to tell me if anything changed. If Sana is-
lines.zh: : 不一样是怎么个不一样？我让你一有变化就告诉我的。如果 Sana 是——

lines.en: : I don’t...no. Not like that, Sara. I doubt she’s the same as {i}us{/i} in regard to the whole “blacking out” phenomenon. But...she did mention having dreams.
lines.zh: : 我不是……不。不是你想的那样，Sara。我不觉得她在「断片」这件事上和{i}我们{/i}一样。但……她确实提到过自己会做梦。

lines.en: : What...kind of dreams? Did she say? Because they could be important. They might...mean something? I don’t know. What were they? Do you know?
lines.zh: : 什么样的……梦？她说了吗？因为那可能很重要。它们也许……意味着什么？我不知道。是什么梦？你知道吗？

lines.en: : I do. I just don’t know if it’s something you want to hear.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我只是不知道那是不是你想听的。

lines.en: : I do. I {i}need{/i} to know if it involves my daughter. Because she hasn’t said anything to me and-
lines.zh: : 我想听。如果牵扯到我女儿，我就{i}必须{/i}知道。因为她什么都没跟我说过，而且——

lines.en: : She’s been dreaming of something...{i}someone{/i} you don’t like talking about.
lines.zh: : 她一直梦见某个……你不喜欢谈的{i}东西{/i}。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck24
: Yeah...But she started changing even before that.
lines.zh: : 是啊……可她在这之前就开始变了。

lines.en: : The thing is, though...I’m pretty sure it’s less of a {i}change{/i} and more of her simply...revealing to me the way she’s always been.
lines.zh: : 问题是……我挺确定，那与其说是{i}变化{/i}，不如说她只是……把她一直以来的样子展露给我看了。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck25
: She’s kind of like a chameleon, if you think about it.
lines.zh: : 你要这么想的话，她有点像变色龙。

lines.en: : She’s great at blending into her surroundings and making herself {i}seem{/i} harmless. But she’s {i}really{/i} an opportunistic hunter waiting for her chance to strike.
lines.zh: : 她很擅长融入周围环境，让自己{i}看起来{/i}无害。但她{i}其实{/i}是个伺机而动的机会主义猎手。

lines.en: : Are you sure we’re talking about the same girl? Because {i}my{/i} Sana isn’t like that at all.
lines.zh: : 你确定我们说的是同一个女孩吗？{i}我的{/i} Sana 可完全不是那样。

lines.en: : Then maybe she’s hiding who she really is from {i}you{/i} too.
lines.zh: : 那也许她也对{i}你{/i}藏着真实的自己。

lines.en: : Why...would she do that, though? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 可她……为什么要那样做？我不明白。

lines.en: : Beats me. People do all sorts of things that I don’t understand. And lately, Sana’s just...started to become one of them.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。人们会做各种我不理解的事。而最近，Sana 也……开始成为其中之一。

lines.en: : I don’t like this.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : Just...part of being a parent, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概……这就是为人父母的一部分吧。

lines.en: : No, I don’t like that you’re hiding something from me about my daughter.
lines.zh: : 不，我不喜欢的是你对我女儿的事对我有所隐瞒。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck26
: You {i}know{/i} how worried I am about her. You know how desperate I am to make sure she doesn’t wind up like me. I offered you my bar. My apartment. Anything you want...
lines.zh: : 你{i}知道{/i}我有多担心她。你知道我有多拼命想确保她不会变成我这样。我把我的酒吧给你。我的公寓。你要什么都行……

lines.en: : So is there just {i}nothing{/i} you want? Or are you hiding whatever’s going on from me for some {i}other{/i} reason? Be real with me, Sensei. As a parent. You’d want to know about Ami, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 那就是说你{i}什么都不{/i}想要？还是你因为{i}别的{/i}理由在瞒着我？跟我说实话，Sensei。作为家长。如果是 Ami 的事，你也想知道吧？

lines.en: : Well...let me ask you this.
lines.zh: : 那么……我问你一句。

lines.en: : If Sana {i}did{/i} become like you — not in the sense of blacking out...or {i}seeing{/i} things...but {i}as a person{/i} — how would you feel about {i}that?{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果 Sana {i}真的{/i}变得像你——不是在断片……或者{i}看见{/i}东西那个意义上——而是{i}作为一个人{/i}变得像你，你会怎么想？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck27
: So {i}that’s{/i} what you mean...
lines.zh: : 原来你说的就是{i}这个{/i}……

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck28
: I guess it really {i}is{/i} in our genes then.
lines.zh: : 那看来这{i}真是{/i}写在我们的基因里了。

lines.en: : ...Sara?
lines.zh: : ……Sara？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck29
: When did it happen?
lines.zh: : 什么时候发生的？

lines.en: : When did...{i}what{/i} happen?
lines.zh: : {i}什么{/i}什么时候发生的？

lines.en: : She came onto you, didn’t she? It was only a matter of time.
lines.zh: : 她主动勾引你了吧？那只是时间问题。

lines.en: : Relax...I’m not {i}mad.{/i} I was the same age as her when I went down that same path, remember?
lines.zh: : 放轻松……我{i}没生气{/i}。我像她这么大的时候也走上了同一条路，记得吗？

lines.en: : It’s not like I can tell her to “learn from my mistakes” or whatever when she quite literally {i}only exists{/i} because of them.
lines.zh: : 毕竟她{i}之所以存在{/i}，靠的就是我的那些「错误」，我也没法跟她说什么「吸取我的教训」之类的。

lines.en: : I regret nothing. And if this is what gets you to keep a closer eye on her, so be it.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不后悔。如果这能让你多盯着她一点，那就这样吧。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Literally any response I make right now would either be incriminating or bad, so I’m just going to keep my mouth shut.
lines.zh: : 我现在不管回什么，要么会把自己送进去，要么会很糟糕，所以我还是闭嘴吧。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck30
: It’s preferable to finding out she’s hallucinating and getting thrown on auto-pilot for hours at a time. At least I know she’d be {i}safe{/i} with you.
lines.zh: : 总比发现她在产生幻觉、然后被自动驾驶模式接管好几个小时要好。至少我知道她跟你在一起是{i}安全{/i}的。

lines.en: : I’m an adult male. Your daughter is in high school and under five feet tall.
lines.zh: : 我是个成年男性。你女儿在上高中，身高还不到五英尺。

lines.en: : I know. Isn’t she just adorable?
lines.zh: : 我知道。她是不是特别可爱？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck31
: Incriminate yourself already! I want to scold you for being a bad boy!
lines.zh: : 快把自己送进去啊！我想骂你是个坏男孩！

lines.en: : I take it you’re just...{i}fine{/i} with her becoming like you, then?
lines.zh: : 那也就是说……她变成你那样，你就……{i}无所谓{/i}咯？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck32

: Mm...I mean {i}ideally,{/i} she’d wait a few more years until her body is fully developed to start fooling around with actual {i}people.{/i} And even more ideally, she wouldn’t come after my boyfriend like this.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我是说，{i}理想情况下{/i}，她该再等几年、等身体发育完全了再跟{i}真人{/i}乱来。而更理想的情况是，她别来追我男朋友。

lines.en: : I’m not your boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 我不是你男朋友。

lines.en: : Yes you are. Shut up.
lines.zh: : 你就是。闭嘴。

lines.en: : I’m trying to. You’re the one who keeps trying to make me talk.
lines.zh: : 我正想闭嘴。是你一直想让我说话。

lines.en: : Uhh, {i}yeah.{/i} Because you totally just admitted that the reason my perfect future family’s in jeopardy is because my daughter is suddenly horny for her prospective daddy.
lines.zh: : 呃，{i}对啊{/i}。因为你刚刚等于承认了，我那个完美未来家庭之所以岌岌可危，是因为我女儿突然对她未来的爸爸发情了。

lines.en: : Going back to silence now. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 我回到沉默模式了。再见。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck33
: If {i}that{/i} is the worst of the changes you’ve seen from Sana, that’s like...the {i}best{/i} case scenario. However, as her mother and your girlfriend, I can not give you my blessing.
lines.zh: : 如果你在 Sana 身上看到的变化最糟也就{i}这样{/i}，那简直……算是{i}最好{/i}的情况了。不过，作为她的母亲、以及你的女朋友，我不能给你我的祝福。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}want{/i} your blessing. That’d be weird as hell.
lines.zh: : 我{i}不要{/i}你的祝福。那也太诡异了。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck34
: Great! That’s settled, then.
lines.zh: : 太好了！那就这么定了。

lines.en: : {i}What{/i} is settled? I have no idea where we even are in this conversation anymore.
lines.zh: : {i}什么{/i}定了？我都不知道我们这对话聊到哪儿了。

lines.en: : We’re at the part where I remind you to keep your eye on my daughter for {i}actual{/i} developments or changes. Not ones everyone and their mother saw coming.
lines.zh: : 聊到我要提醒你，要盯着我女儿身上{i}真正{/i}的进展或变化。而不是那种谁都看得出来的变化。

lines.en: : Get it? Because {i}I’m{/i} her mother.
lines.zh: : 懂了吗？因为她妈妈{i}我{/i}早就看出来了。

lines.en: : And I could tell she was hot for teacher just like me.
lines.zh: : 而且我一眼就看出来，她跟我一样对老师发情。

lines.en: : Yeah, I get it.
lines.zh: : 行，我懂了。

lines.en: : So you agree then?
lines.zh: : 那你同意咯？

lines.en: : To...have sex with your daughter?
lines.zh: : 同意……跟你女儿上床？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck35
: Noooo! To tell me if and when something is wrong! {i}I’m{/i} the one who gets to have sex with you! I worked for it! She can’t just swoop in and steal you! That’s not fair!
lines.zh: : 不是啦！是同意一有不对劲就告诉我！能跟你上床的人{i}是我{/i}！我可是努力争取来的！她不能就这么冲进来把你抢走！这不公平！

lines.en: : Of course I’ll tell you if something’s wrong, Sara. But...I’d feel wrong if I didn’t make it abundantly clear that I might {i}not{/i} know something like that.
lines.zh: : 我当然会告诉你有什么不对劲，Sara。但是……如果不把话说清楚，我心里会过意{i}不{/i}去——那种事我可能真的看不出来。

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck36
: If Sana kept her feelings about {i}me{/i} hidden for so long, who even knows what else she could be hiding? Revealing intimate details just...isn’t a thing she does?
lines.zh: : 如果 Sana 把{i}自己{/i}的感情藏了那么久，谁知道她还藏着什么？吐露私密的心事……本来就不是她会做的事？

lines.en: : Then...what are we supposed to do?
lines.zh: : 那……我们该怎么办？

lines.en: : I don’t know...Wait and see if she tackles one of us to the ground and fucks us in the ass?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……等着看她会不会把咱俩其中一个扑倒在地、把我们的屁股给操了？

lines.en: scene sarayukicheck37
: Ugh! {i}Again?!{/i} I can only take so much!
lines.zh: : 呃！{i}又来？！{/i}我可承受不了这么多！

lines.en: : Better you than me.
lines.zh: : 你总比我强。

lines.en: : Yeah because {i}you’d{/i} get to stand there and watch while I’m sodomized and forced to figure out how to tell Sana she just screwed her own mom.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为{i}你可以{/i}站在旁边看着我被爆菊，还得逼我想办法告诉 Sana，她刚刚把她亲妈给操了。

lines.en: : You’d let me watch?
lines.zh: : 你会让我看？

lines.en: : Might as well. We’re already doing it.
lines.zh: : 反正看都看了。我们不是已经在这么干了吗。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m going to have a lot of trouble figuring out if this makes you a better or worse mom when I’m getting into bed tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚躺到床上的时候，我会有大麻烦，搞不清这到底让你成了个更好的妈，还是更糟的妈。

lines.en: : Aww, you think about me in bed? That’s so sweet! I do the same thing. Sana too, apparently.
lines.zh: : 呜哇，你躺床上的时候会想我？太甜了！我也一样。Sana 显然也是。

lines.en: : Sara...
lines.zh: : Sara……

lines.en: : Boyfriend...
lines.zh: : 男朋友……

lines.en: : How about we just...drop it? We’ll be at Yuki’s soon anyway.
lines.zh: : 我们要不就……到此为止吧？反正也快到 Yuki 家了。

lines.en: : Works for me!
lines.zh: : 正合我意！

lines.en: : You know, Yuki would probably let you screw her daughter too. She gets it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Yuki 大概也会让你操她女儿的。她懂的。

lines.en: : I don’t think either of you get it...
lines.zh: : 我觉得你们俩谁都不懂……
